summary: Expose explicit SSOT review backlog export through the Wellman CLI

delivery.outcome: Expose opt-in evidence-bound SSOT backlog export in CLI with bounded explicit source context, accurate receipts, documentation, independent merge and installed CLI smoke.
nonGoals: No analyzer execution, automatic refactoring, adoption or remote synchronization
No global runtime replacement or foreign worktree cleanup

architecture.decision: Pair --export-planfile with --export-context on ssot. Parse closed bounded context JSON and bind relative source/artifact paths to its directory. Reuse the merged native adapter for live freshness, artifact hashes, dedupe and ownership preservation; print the unmodified analysis or export receipt according to the explicit mode.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of additive CLI mode; retain created backlog records for explicit owner disposition.

validation.evidence: Opt-in only; bounded input, source/artifact drift refusal, local backlog dedupe/terminal preservation and useful receipts.
All tests with isolated fixture storage, governance and exact-head independent review/merge.

commands: isolated installed wellman ssot backlog smoke
validation.evidence: Merged wheel CLI creates human backlog, reuses it and rejects changed evidence.
